title: CSIR-CRRI Wins Prestigious CII 4R Awards 2026 for Pioneering Steel Slag Road Technology and ECOFIX; recognized among India's Top 30 Waste-to-Worth Leaders
body_text: The CSIR-Central Road Research Institute (CSIR-CRRI), New Delhi, has been conferred the prestigious CII 4R Awards 2026 under the category of “Excellence in Innovative Solutions for Sustainable Waste Management by Research Labs/Academic Institutions.” The Institute has also been recognized among India's Top 30 Waste-to-Worth Leaders for its pioneering Steel Slag Road® Technology and ECOFIX® – Iron and Steel Slag-based Instant Pothole Repair Mix, which transform industrial waste generated by the steel industry into valuable materials for sustainable road construction and maintenance. The awards were presented on 26th November 2026 during the 11th International Conference on Waste-to-Worth Technologies at Hotel the Lalit, New Delhi. Dr. Ch. Ravi Sekhar, Director, CSIR-CRRI, and Shri Satish Pandey, Scientist G and Head, Flexible Pavement Division, CSIR-CRRI, received the award on behalf of the Institute from Prof. Anil Gupta, prominent Indian scholar of grassroots innovation and founder of the Honey Bee Network. Speaking on the occasion, Shri Satish Pandey, Scientist G and Head, Flexible Pavement Division, CSIR-CRRI, and inventor of the Steel Slag Road® and ECOFIX® technologies, highlighted the enormous potential of these innovations in addressing the challenge of industrial waste generated by India's steel industries. He emphasized that the steel industry generates approximately 30 million tonnes of steel slag and that CSIR-CRRI's technologies enable the scientific processing and use of steel slag as processed aggregates for sustainable road infrastructure. These innovations offer an effective pathway for converting large-scale industrial waste into valuable construction materials, reducing dependence on conventional natural aggregates and promoting circular economy practices in the road sector. Transforming Industrial Waste into Sustainable Infrastructure The Steel Slag Road® Technology, developed by CSIR-CRRI, demonstrates the utilization of scientifically processed steel slag aggregates in road construction. It provides a sustainable pathway for converting steel industry by-products into valuable road construction materials, promoting resource efficiency and reducing the environmental burden associated with industrial waste disposal and extraction of natural aggregates. Similarly, ECOFIX®, an iron and steel slag-based instant pothole repair mix, offers an innovative solution for road maintenance through the productive utilization of industrial by-products. Its commercialization by RAMUKA GLOBAL SERVICES under a CSIR-CRRI technology license demonstrates how indigenous research can be translated into market-ready solutions through effective collaboration between research institutions and startups. Together, these technologies exemplify the principles of a circular economy by transforming industrial waste into valuable resources for infrastructure development. With the steel industry generating substantial quantities of slag annually, wider adoption of such technologies can create significant opportunities for resource recovery, sustainable construction and environmentally responsible infrastructure development. CSIR-CRRI Showcases World's First Steel Slag Road Model at the Exhibition As part of the conference exhibition, CSIR-CRRI also showcased a model depicting the World's First Steel Slag Road, constructed at Hazira, Surat, Gujarat, using scientifically processed steel slag aggregates. The exhibition model highlighted the pioneering application of steel industry waste in road infrastructure and demonstrated how indigenous research and technological innovation can transform industrial by-products into valuable construction materials. The showcase attracted attention to CSIR-CRRI's efforts towards promoting sustainable road construction, industrial waste utilization and circular economy practices in the transportation infrastructure sector. The CII 4R Awards recognize outstanding contributions towards sustainable waste management, resource efficiency and innovative solutions based on the principles of Reduce, Reuse, Recycle and Repair. The recognition of CSIR-CRRI and RAMUKA GLOBAL SERVICES highlights the complementary roles of scientific research, technology transfer, entrepreneurship and commercialization in addressing India's industrial waste management challenges. This achievement reflects CSIR-CRRI's continued commitment to developing indigenous, sustainable and scalable technologies for national infrastructure development. It also demonstrates the growing contribution of research institutions and technology-driven startups towards realizing India's vision of a circular economy, resource efficiency and Viksit Bharat 2047. About CSIR-CRRI CSIR-Central Road Research Institute (CSIR-CRRI), New Delhi, is a constituent laboratory of the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India. The Institute undertakes research and development in road and transportation engineering and allied areas, contributing to safe, sustainable, efficient, and resilient infrastructure through scientific research, innovation, and technological advancement. ***** SG/AK
